format: Descriptive kinematic relationships, not embedded STEP mates or executable controller
hierarchy: W01 fixed wall -> root Y carriage -> yaw Z -> pitch Y 1/2/3/4 -> L4 prismatic X
P03 fixed rail -> Y carriage -> original wrist bracket proxy
F04 single membrane -> 3 bonded bands/webs/beads -> 18 Y-sliding releasable carriers
support_constraint: When engaged: root Y = P03 carriage Y = carrier Y. Wrist datum X4500/Z0; no yaw during sync.

F04_carrier.positive_retention: two X-opening lips, closed center slot 4 mm > web 1.5 mm and < bead diameter 12 mm
F04_carrier.release: both lips open 24 mm each; head lowers 80 mm before arm motion

animation_sequence_s.0-6: all root and front Y carriages synchronous quintic shift
animation_sequence_s.6-8: open six carrier gates on arms 2/5
animation_sequence_s.10-14: L4 of 2/5 retracts 1600 -> 1000; original wrist latch unresolved
animation_sequence_s.14-18: root pitch 2/5 decreases 6 degrees; other relative pitches fixed
